extDescription.message: Transcribes your Google Meet meetings to Markdown, with the name of who is speaking. No bot joins the call and nothing leaves your computer.

statusReady.message: This meeting is not being transcribed

confirmDelete.message: Delete “$1” from the browser? The file in Downloads is not touched.

settingAutoStart.message: Transcribe automatically when I join a meeting

settingLanguageWarning.message: Warn me if the caption language is not my browser’s language

searchPlaceholder.message: Search by title, person or text

alertCaptionsOff.message: Captions are off and could not be turned on.

alertUnreadable.message: There are captions on screen but they cannot be read. Google Meet may have changed.

notifyLanguage.message: Transcribing in $1. If the meeting is in another language, change it from the extension icon.

notifyLanguageMismatch.message: Captions are in $1 and your browser is in $2. If the meeting is in $2, change it from the extension icon.
